description.value: A Japanese sushi restaurant situated in a strip mall on King George Boulevard in Surrey, BC. The restaurant offers dine-in service and online ordering, making it a convenient stop for a hot meal on a long King George corridor ride. The OSM record lists it as wheelchair accessible.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at sushikinggeorge.com identifies the business as 'Sushi sen', not 'Sushi King George' as in OSM — likely a rebrand — but phone (778-395-8989) and address (#102-10344 King George Blvd, Surrey) both match OSM exactly. The website prominently advertises 'NOW TAKING ONLINE ORDERS!' confirming takeout is available. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM lists this as 'Sushi King George' but the website title and branding identify the business as 'Sushi sen'. This likely reflects a rebrand; the OSM record may need updating.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open Japanese restaurant with a confirmed address and phone number on a major cycling corridor in Surrey.
